what: safe_step_value is not actually parser-safe for step-family values because globs like 8[[:alnum:]-]* allow arbitrary trailing bytes after the first safe character, and issue-input-file copies the result into the public ### title
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed classification env with STALL_STEP=8a unsafe text produces a public issue title outside the claimed sanitized step token, so the plan's no-script-change assumption is false
suggested_fix: Tighten safe_step_value with a full-string regex or closed enum for the intended step tokens before composing the title, and add one regression fixture for an 8a-prefixed unsafe value
